annotations.title: Check an invoice for duplicates before the agent pays

description: Duplicate invoice check before an agent pays. Same as judge with one duplicate check: it compares this invoice with the invoices this API key recorded earlier and also judges it. Call it before an agent pays or approves an invoice or payment instruction. Inputs: the judge inputs (task, agent_output as the invoice JSON, evidence, criteria, checks, mode, tags) plus duplicate {vendor_path, invoice_id_path, amount_path, currency_path?, date_path?, window_days?, store?, retain_days?}. Returns the judge result plus duplicate.status (unique, duplicate, possible_duplicate, replay or not_checked). On duplicate or possible_duplicate, next_step.action is escalate: do not pay. Needs Authorization: Bearer, because fingerprints are kept per key; only keyed HMAC fingerprints are stored, and only when store is true. Cost: 1 call, the same price as judge. Without a key or payment, tools/call is HTTP 200 with isError true and the x402 PaymentRequirements in structuredContent; an x402 payment without a key returns key_required and is not settled.

agent_id.description: Optional tag for the agent making this call. 1 to 64 characters: letters, digits, and . _ : -. This is not the per-answer agent_id on a consensus answer.

agent_output.description: The invoice or payment instruction the agent is about to pay, as a JSON string.

checks.description: Optional. The worker runs each check. A failed check forces verdict fail. Types: url_contains, json_schema, equals, regex, numeric, onchain, required_fields, types, format, sum, duplicate. duplicate (at most 1, API key only) compares an invoice with ones this key recorded earlier and stores keyed fingerprints only when store is true. At most 3 url_contains checks. Local checks run first; if one fails, no model is called and next_step says what to fix.

items.description: Dot path into the output JSON, at most 8 segments, e.g. invoice.total or items.0.id.

field.description: Dot path into the output JSON, at most 8 segments, e.g. invoice.total or items.0.id.

oneOf.description: Existing types, unchanged: url_contains, json_schema, equals, regex, numeric, onchain.

criteria.description: Optional. Facts or terms the answer must contain, one per string.

duplicate.description: The duplicate check: dot paths into agent_output for vendor, invoice id and amount, plus optional currency_path, date_path, window_days, store and retain_days. store true records this invoice's keyed fingerprints so later calls can match it.

amount_path.description: Dot path into the output JSON, at most 8 segments, e.g. invoice.total or items.0.id.

currency_path.description: Dot path into the output JSON, at most 8 segments, e.g. invoice.total or items.0.id.

date_path.description: Dot path to a YYYY-MM-DD invoice date. Enables the same vendor, amount and date rule.

invoice_id_path.description: Dot path into the output JSON, at most 8 segments, e.g. invoice.total or items.0.id.

store.description: Record this invoice's fingerprints so later calls can match it.

vendor_path.description: Dot path into the output JSON, at most 8 segments, e.g. invoice.total or items.0.id.

evidence.description: Optional. Source passages the answer must be grounded in, one string per passage. Without evidence, grounding cannot be checked.

mode.description: Optional. blocking (the default) is today's behaviour. advisory computes the same verdict, checks, next_step and receipt, then adds mode, decision_owner human, recommended_action (approve, review or return) and a notice. The receipt signs mode advisory as schema_version 5. Same price.

retain.description: Optional. true stores this call for 24 hours; requires an API key. Default false stores nothing.

share.description: Optional. false keeps this call out of opt-in data sharing even when the key has sharing on. It cannot turn sharing on.

task.description: The original instruction or question the agent was answering.

version.description: Optional version tag for that agent. At most 64 characters.

name: check_duplicate_invoice

agent_id.description: Echoed when the call sent an agent_id tag.

decision_owner.description: Advisory only. A person owns the decision.

duplicate.description: Present only when the call sent a duplicate check. status is unique, duplicate, possible_duplicate, replay or not_checked. Carries no invoice data.

engine.description: groq, workers_ai, deterministic, or demo. Also signed into the receipt.

fail_closed.description: Present and true only when a finance check failed closed because the primary model was unavailable. Treat it as review.

mode.description: Present only when the call sent mode: advisory.

action.description: pass: use the output. retry: fix it using hint and call again. escalate: stop and hand to a person.

hint.description: Template text naming fields and types to fix. Never contains values from agent_output.

notice.description: Advisory only. Fixed text: the call does not approve, hold or release any payment.

agent_id.description: Present when the call sent an agent_id tag. Omitted otherwise. Older receipts omit it.

checks.description: Type, passed, and evidence_hash only. Fetched page text and chain responses are not stored.

engine.description: groq, workers_ai, deterministic, or demo. Present on schema 3 and 4.

mode.description: Present only on schema 5 and 8: the call was advisory, so a person, not the API, owned the decision. Blocking receipts omit it.

model.description: Present only on schema 7 and 8: the model id the provider echoed back for this verdict, for example openai/gpt-oss-120b. Signed, so a changed model id fails verification.

payment.description: x402 includes tx, network, and payer. Schema 4 free-key and prepaid payments are the label only, with no key_prefix. Schema 3 may include the key display prefix, not the secret. demo is the /try/ allowance.

key_prefix.description: Present on schema 3 free-key and prepaid payments. Omitted on schema 4. Never the secret.

tx.description: Settled transaction id, or the accepted payment nonce when nothing was settled.

request_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the normalized request. Judge requests include task, agent_output, evidence, and criteria. Consensus requests include task and answers, plus evidence when it was sent. agent_id and version tags are signed separately and are not part of this hash.

schema_version.description: 7 is schema 4 plus a signed model id, and 8 is schema 5 plus a signed model id: minted when a model gave the verdict. 5 is schema 4 plus a signed mode advisory, minted only for mode: advisory calls. 4 omits key_prefix from payment so a published receipt verifies without key info. 3 adds verification, engine, checks (type, passed, and evidence_hash only), and a claims count, and may include key_prefix. 2 can carry agent_id and version. Older receipts omit this field and still verify.

score.description: Judge score from 0 to 1. For consensus this is agreement_score.

signature.description: Unpadded base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of every field except signature.

verdict.description: Judge verdict (pass, fail, or retry). For consensus this is false_consensus_risk (low, medium, or high).

verification.description: verified when a check of the answer passed. judged when a model checked it and did not contradict it. heuristic when only string checks ran. failed when the agreed answer failed verification.

version.description: Present when the call sent a version tag. Omitted otherwise. Older receipts omit it.

recommended_action.description: Advisory only, deterministic and not signed. Judge: next_step pass is approve, escalate is review, retry is return (send back to the agent). Consensus: risk low is approve, medium or high is review.

score.description: null when no model gave a verdict (degraded).

version.description: Echoed when the call sent a version tag.
